# dspc_group_member (Resource)

Manages the membership of a user in a authorization group. Note: the authorization API does not expose a read endpoint for group membership, so drift cannot be detected — the resource relies on Terraform state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_name` (String) The name of the group.
- `user_id` (String) The ID of the user to add to the group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier for this membership, in the format "group_name:user_id".
